annotation.evidence_span: All other values MUST be ignored when processing a packet that contains an unsupported version.
annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation should ignore all fields except the Version field, i.e., it must still read the Version field but discard all other packet contents.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation should ignore the entire packet, including the Version field, treating it as if it were not present.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the Version field itself is to be retained or discarded, leaving two materially different implementation behaviours.
